notes.title: Version 0.20.0
notes.notes:
[p]New features and stuff:
[/p][list][*][p]Lobby chat and game chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Some visual enhancements to the game map.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.19.0
notes.notes: [p]Small tweaks here and there and most notably finally added number groups to units.[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.18.3
notes.notes: [p]Lots of new stuff:[/p][list][*][p]New unit: Medic. Heal those troops so they can get back to lasering.[/p][/*][*][p]New building: Supply Depot. Get those supplies to you faster so you can invest that precious LC to the war effort.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the networking code in some places and removed stupid things. Now everything runs nice and smooth even if the latency is a little bit under 200ms! (Who plays in lobbies where the latency is so high?)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few bugs here and there.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.17.5
notes.notes:
[p]Hotfix 5 changelog:
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed another game crashing bug with unit movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the current one and only game map a bit to fix balance.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.17.4
notes.notes: [p]Lots of general improvements and additions in version 0.17. [/p][p]Hotfix 4 fixes an annoying fatal bug that was caught during playtesting.[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.16.0
notes.notes: [p]Lots of cool stuff including a proper main menu finally and lobby listings. Everything is subject to change but it looks good IMO.[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.13.0
notes.notes:
[p]New stuff:
[/p][list][*][p]A nice minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Some new music.[/p][/*][*][p]Network syncing is now smoother. Its hard to explain but you will see it.[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of fixes and small additions.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.12.0
notes.notes: [p]Added:[/p][list][*][p]Win conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Music[/p][/*][*][p]Sound stuff[/p][/*][*][p]Some fixes here and there.[/p][/*][*][p]Bedrock for the resource system.[/p][/*][*][p]Things now cost LC (Laser credits) to build.[/p][/*][*][p]Some other stuff I probably forgot already.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.11.0
notes.notes: [p]Settting in place bedrocks for upcoming features. Lots of cool stuff added and fixed a few things. Check it out![/p]

notes.title: Version 0.8.0 Released
notes.notes: [p]Changes and fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Lots of small fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Proper pathfinding.[/p][/*][*][p]Animations for units.[/p][/*][*][p]Synchronized peer to peer requests.[/p][/*][/list][p]Known bugs and missing stuff:[/p][list][*][p]There is a small bug with unit movement that rarely causes units to get stuck. This will be fixed in the next version.[/p][/*][*][p]No request buffering yet. This will be implemented in the next version. Until then you will experience a small "twitching" effect when stuff happens.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]
